item.title: Warwick traffic cameras generated nearly $659K in revenue last year
item.description: The city of Warwick raked in nearly $659,000 from its traffic enforcement cameras in their first year, 12 News has learned.

item.title: Study suggests Trump's unproven autism claims influenced care
item.description: Last year, President Donald Trump told pregnant women not to take Tylenol as he promoted unproven ties between the fever reducer and autism and touted an old generic drug as a treatment for the developmental condition.

item.title: 1 recovered, 1 missing after fishing vessel overturns off Cape Cod
item.description: A commercial fishing vessel overturned off Cape Cod on Thursday, prompting a search in which one person was recovered from the water and the other is still missing, U.S. Coast Guard officials said.

item.title: 'Just trying to help': Good Samaritan seriously hurt trying to assist driver in Freetown
item.description: "You never think you might lose someone," Molly Alfi said, her voice breaking, standing outside St. Luke's Hospital in New Bedford. "We just got married."

item.title: FIFA formally agrees to pay World Cup security funding; Foxboro says it's still not enough
item.description: The Boston Host Committee for the FIFA World Cup 2026 and the Kraft Sports Group have formally agreed to pay the $7.8 million in security costs for the matches, according to a letter sent to the board Thursday.

item.title: Lawmaker continues pushing for reforms after release of clergy sex abuse report
item.description: Rhode Island Attorney General Peter Neronha is urging state lawmakers to pass legislation that would hold the Diocese of Providence accountable for the actions of the 72 credibly accused priests revealed in his sweeping clergy sex abuse report.

item.title: Friend recounts day Providence teen was killed in 2024 shooting
item.description: Three men appeared in court Thursday for a bail hearing, all accused in the deadly shooting of a Providence teen on his 18th birthday.

item.title: Blackstone Valley Prep teacher charged with 2nd-degree child abuse
item.description: A teacher at Blackstone Valley Prep School has been arrested, accused of assaulting three students under 10 years old, according to police.

item.title: Worst roads, high costs: Why RIDOT struggles with paving despite $1 billion transportation budget
item.description: The condition of Rhode Island's state roads is so bad it was -- literally -- off the chart in a recent study.
